title: Privacy Preserving Synthetic Data Generation on Full MIMIC III Dataset
summary: A research pipeline that preprocesses multiple MIMIC III clinical tables and trains generative models table-by-table to produce privacy-preserving synthetic healthcare data, evaluating statistical fidelity and downstream ML utility against real data. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer (and compares against CTGANSynthesizer) via sdv.single_table, using SingleTableMetadata for schema detection.
